items.title: How Nvidia Chips Ended Up Within Reach of China’s Military
items.summary: Alibaba, the Chinese internet giant behind the company at the center of the Nvidia spy saga, has used its A.I. computing technology to aid a lab with links to China’s military.

items.title: How We Broke Open the Nvidia Investigation
items.summary: A global reporting effort by The New York Times included many twists and turns, from surprising photos and shipment records to a big break through astonishing tips from sources.

items.title: Anthropic Sells $81.3 Billion in Shares for a Record IPO
items.summary: The sale valued the A.I. company, which makes the Claude chatbot, at more than $1.5 trillion. Shares begin trading on Thursday.

items.title: That ‘SNL’ Sister Sketch: It’s More Like Nonfiction

items.title: Ericka Lomick’s Texas House Win Faces Challenge in State Supreme Court

items.title: Alaska Republican Narrowly Defeats Independent House Candidate

items.title: The law releasing the Epstein files passed one year ago. What do his victims say?

items.title: Democratic Black women take over almost all state agencies in Georgia soon
